items.t: Defibrillator on top, airway, drug and IV drawers below, oxygen and suction at t

A black oxygen cylinder with a white shoulder is strapped to the left side. A blue suction unit with a curved tube stands on the right.

items.t: Four causes to check: the tongue, the vocal cords, opioids and weak breathing mu
items.a: Left: a side view of the head and neck. The pink tongue has fallen back against the back wall of the throat, narrowing the pale blue airway. Below it are the epiglottis, the purple vocal cords and the trachea. A green arrow under the chin points forward. Right top: an eye with a pinpoint pupil. Right bottom: a chest with two lungs and a dashed purple diaphragm.

items.t: Count PONV risk factors, treat pain early and keep the patient warm.
items.a: Four panels. Top left: a blue kidney dish with two green drops above it. Top right: four amber circles hold a female sign, a crossed-out cigarette, two wavy lines and an ampoule. Five bars below them grow taller. Bottom left: a frowning face beside a red zigzag. Bottom right: a thermometer with a low blue column and a blue zigzag. A person lies under a red warming blanket fed by a hose.
items.rn: Count PONV risk factors, treat pain early and keep the patient warm.

items.t: The modified Aldrete score: five items, 0 to 2 each. A total of 9 or more allows
items.a: A score card with five rows. Row icons: a stick figure, lungs, a heart, an open eye and a finger with a red clip. Each row has three boxes holding no dot, one dot and two dots, with one box shaded green. To the right is a bar of ten blocks, nine green and one grey. An amber line sits before the ninth block, with a small bed below.
items.rn: The modified Aldrete score: five items, 0 to 2 each. A total of 9 or more allows

items.a: A top-down view of one ICU bed space. A patient lies on a bed with a ventilator at the head and a monitor beside it. Three infusion pumps hang on a pole. A sink sits by the entrance and a hand rub bottle at the foot of the bed. Outside is a nursing station with two screens.
items.rn: One ICU bed space: organ support, monitoring, infusions, hand hygiene and a watc

items.a: A flow from left to right. A ward bed sits under a red line that climbs. An arrow leads to an amber diamond gate. The next box is red and holds an ICU bed with a monitor. Next comes a green diamond gate and a ward bed with a green outline. From the amber gate, an arrow points down to a purple box with a heart.

items.t: Airway, eyes, head-up position, feeding tube, bladder and heels all need care.
items.a: Side view of a patient on an ICU bed with the head end raised. A purple tube leaves the mouth. A small strip covers the closed eye. A dashed orange line runs from the nose to the stomach. items.rn: Airway, eyes, head-up position, feeding tube, bladder and heels all need care.

items.t: Five oxygen devices, and the two usual SpO2 target ranges.
items.a: Five faces in a row, each with an oxygen device. From left: thin nasal prongs, a simple green mask, and a mask with a blue valve on its tube. Then a mask with a hanging reservoir bag, and wide purple prongs joined to a humidifier box. Below is a grey bar with an amber band and a green band.
items.rn: Five oxygen devices, and the two usual SpO2 target ranges.

items.t: Supply, power, screen, humidifier, circuit and test lung: check each before the
items.a: A ventilator stands on the left. Its dark screen shows a yellow pressure wave and a blue flow wave above three dials. Green and grey hoses run down from it to the floor, beside a black power cable. Two ribbed tubes leave its side: the upper one passes a humidifier chamber with water. Both tubes join at a Y-piece attached to a pink test lung.
items.rn: Supply, power, screen, humidifier, circuit and test lung: check each before the

items.t: Waves on the monitor, urine in the bag and the sedation target on the RASS scale
items.a: A dark bedside monitor with four waves: green ECG, red arterial pressure, blue pulse oximetry and yellow capnography. On the right hangs a urine bag with yellow urine and scale marks. Along the bottom runs a row of ten coloured blocks from blue through green to red. Two small dark triangles point at the two green blocks.
items.rn: Waves on the monitor, urine in the bag and the sedation target on the RASS scale

items.t: From the nerve ending to the brain, and the brain's own brake back down.
items.a: A red star on a strip of skin sends two fibres to a small purple ganglion. One is dashed blue, one thin red. The fibres enter a cross-section of the spinal cord with a grey butterfly centre. A red line crosses the cord and rises to a purple oval inside a pink brain. A dashed green line runs back down from the brain to the cord.
items.rn: From the nerve ending to the brain, and the brain's own brake back down.

items.t: Choose the pain scale to suit the patient: numbers, faces or behaviour.
items.a: Top: six faces in a row, from a broad smile to a deep frown with a tear. Middle: a bar of ten colour blocks from green to red, with eleven tick marks. Bottom: a child figure and a head on a pillow with a tube from the mouth. Last, a body outline with a red spot.
items.rn: Choose the pain scale to suit the patient: numbers, faces or behaviour.

items.t: The three steps of the WHO ladder, with adjuvants available at every step.
items.a: A three-step staircase rising to the right: green, amber and red steps. The green step holds a white tablet and a yellow capsule. The amber step holds a purple capsule and a white tablet. The red step holds a blue ampoule and a blue tablet. A red arrow climbs the stairs. A purple rail with three capsules stands at the right.
items.rn: The three steps of the WHO ladder, with adjuvants available at every step.

items.t: Paracetamol, an NSAID, a nerve block, PCA and cold together, with sedation watch
items.a: A patient figure with a red zigzag wound on the abdomen sits in the centre. Dashed lines join it to six items. They are a white tablet, a yellow capsule, a syringe aimed at a nerve and a purple pump. The last two are a blue cold pack and a half-closed eye in a dashed amber circle.
items.rn: Paracetamol, an NSAID, a nerve block, PCA and cold together, with sedation watch
